title: Habit, Not Infrastructure: replication package for Truong Tho Living Lab Paper 3 (Metro Line 1 behavioural baseline, Ho Chi Minh City)

creators.name: Lê, Ngọc Hiếu
creators.affiliation: Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology; University of Health Sciences, VNU-HCM

description:
Replication package for Paper 3 of the Truong Tho Living Lab: a behavioural baseline of motorcycle lock-in on the eve of Metro Line 1 commercial service in Ho Chi Minh City.

The package contains the analysis notebook, 12 figures, 19 tables, results.json (every manuscript statistic), public (coordinate-stripped) analysis files, GHSL study-window clips, and the PCI files used in the institutional benchmark.

Survey microdata with household coordinates are withheld and available from the corresponding author under a data-use agreement.
